sandbachFocus: Sandbach United host Eccleshall at the Sandbach Community Football Centre on Saturday at 15:00, and they've already played this fixture this week, winning 2-0 with goals from Josh Fowles and Kyle Foley. The Ramblers sit top of the table with 22 points from 10 games and a five-game unbeaten run, while Eccleshall, who lie in 5th place with 18 points, suffered their first defeat in four matches in that encounter.
divisionWide: Stafford Town drew 3-3 with Cheadle Heath Nomads after playing with 10 men for much of the second half, securing a point that keeps them in 2nd place. Wolverhampton Casuals extended their strong form with a 3-1 away victory at Shawbury United, moving to 4th place. AFC Bridgnorth's impressive run ended with a 1-0 home defeat to Brereton Social, who showed resilience in an upset result. Bilston Town dominated Market Drayton Town 3-0 at home in a one-sided affair, with Drayton reduced to 10 men early on. Allscott Heath secured a dominant 4-1 home win over struggling Alsager Town, maintaining their rise up the table. Barnton picked up a crucial 2-0 away victory at Telford Town to extend their unbeaten league run. Dawley Town claimed an impressive 2-1 away win at New Mills, with goals from the Dent brothers. Wednesfield Community returned to winning ways with a 1-0 away victory at Crewe, earning their first clean sheet of the season. Foley Meir face Widnes Town at Trentham Foods Stadium, with Widnes in desperate form at the bottom of the table.
